items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 25:1
items.html: Since the source of the soul of Adam HaRishon is phase four, as above in answer 276, and it is called the point of the middle [Nekuda de-Emtsa'ita], because it is the axis around which, in order to correct it, all the worlds revolve — therefore also Adam HaRishon, whose source is phase four, includes all the worlds; and when he corrects himself, all the worlds are corrected through him. (Ibid.)
